response.query: Generate a scintific personality traits description of this real-world scientist : Dr. Jane Smith is a leading researcher in cellular and transcriptional profiling of the adult human utricle and its response to ototoxic damage. Her work reveals regeneration mechanisms and damage responses. She is highly cited in this field.
response.answer: Dr. Jane Smith is a leading researcher in cellular and transcriptional profiling of the adult human utricle, focusing on regeneration mechanisms and ototoxic damage responses. She has published influential work on risk genes for hearing difficulty and epidermal growth factor receptor inhibitors for hearing loss. Highly cited in her field.
